content_of_post_to_comment: To parking space backer inners - I must know. What is the appeal? How much time are you saving on the back end of your parking experience? I can guarantee it takes me less time to back out than you to back in.
comment: Backing in trades a few seconds now for easier access later, but the real calculation is whether that convenience matters more than the extra maneuvering time for everyone waiting behind you. Parking is a surprisingly social decision.
